verse.verse_1: Have you heard about the Overwhelming Event?
verse.verse_2: On that Day, there shall be downcast faces,
verse.verse_4: they shall enter a burning Fire
verse.verse_5: and will be made to drink from a boiling spring,
verse.verse_6: they shall have no food but thorns,
verse.verse_7: which will neither nourish nor satisfy hunger.
verse.verse_8: Some faces on that Day will be radiant,
verse.verse_9: well pleased with the result of their striving,
verse.verse_11: where they will hear no idle talk,
verse.verse_17: Do they never reflect on the camels and how they were created,
verse.verse_18: and on the sky, how it is raised aloft,
verse.verse_19: and on the mountains, how they are firmly set up,
verse.verse_20: and on the earth, how it is spread out?
verse.verse_21: So, [O Prophet] exhort them: your task is only to exhort,
verse.verse_23: But whoever turns back and denies the truth,
verse.verse_24: will be punished by God with the greatest punishment.
verse.verse_25: Certainly, it is to Us that they will return.
verse.verse_26: Then, surely, it is for Us to call them to account.
